verdict.rationale: Cost controls are a fair axis for a managed ClickHouse service, but the pack documents no budgets, spend caps, auto-suspend of idle compute, or automatic killing of runaway queries. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit. SQL-based alert rules with Slack and webhook destinations only notify; they do not stop anything. Pausing or cancelling batch jobs and resizing compute are manual operations, not automatic guards against overnight spend.
